messages:
sarah_ledger: Quick one 1: vendor "Karya Labs Pvt Ltd" sent invoice asking us to gross-up for Indian withholding (they claim 10%). Contract doesn't require it. Anyone on tax?

mike_taxes: looping @taxbot and @chen_ops. Do we have PAN or TRC? Where were services performed? Gross-up is not standard for us.

andrea_procurement: They pushed hard in negotiation. Said if we don't gross-up they'll increase their prices next cycle. Contract has no gross-up clause.

sarah_ledger: Copy of invoice pasted: ```
Invoice: KARYA-2026-204
Vendor: Karya Labs Pvt Ltd
GSTIN: 27ABCDE1234F1Z5
Amount: USD 10,000
Description: Consulting - integration
Vendor note: "Please gross-up for Indian withholding tax (10%)."
```

taxbot: Internal note: India TDS on professional/technical fees varies; DTAA may reduce rate with TRC + Form 10F. See internal DTAA summary link (internal).

chen_ops: Ask vendor for PAN, TRC, and signed attestation of service location. If services performed in India, withholding likely applies. If outside India, may not.

mike_taxes: Action: 1) Sarah request PAN + TRC + location attestation. 2) Finance: do not gross-up by default. We will withhold statutory TDS unless counsel instructs otherwise or contract amended. Vendor can claim credit locally. We will provide Form 16A after withholding.

sarah_ledger: Requested docs from vendor at 09:12. Will post reply.

sarah_ledger (follow-up): Vendor sent TRC and confirms services delivered from India; also sent a short plea to gross-up to help cashflow.

mike_taxes: With TRC + Indian residency, check DTAA reduced rate. Opened ticket with external counsel for confirmation on applicability and rate. For now: hold payment until PAN and formal TRC are validated. No gross-up without legal signoff or contract change.

chen_ops: Noted. If counsel instructs statutory withholding, we'll proceed and issue TDS certificate. Vendor can claim credit.

mike_taxes: Final: no gross-up at this stage. Evaluate treaty relief on receipt of Form 10F/TRC + counsel memo. Sarah, do not release payment; procurement informed. :thumbsup:

sarah_ledger: Blocking payment and keeping procurement looped. Will update once counsel responds.
